use.flag: Enable journald logging via sys-apps/systemd's libsystemd
Build the bundled web UI (requires network access at build time to fetch npm packages; disable for a fully offline/hermetic build with just the API and a static status page)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Lemonade is a local AI server from AMD that runs LLMs, speech, and image-generation models on personal GPUs and NPUs through an OpenAI-compatible API, with pluggable backends such as llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion.cpp, FastFlowLM, and RyzenAI. This package provides the `lemond` server daemon (which also serves the bundled web UI with USE=webapp) and the `lemonade` CLI client; the separate native Tauri desktop app is not built.
